sn37.14:1.1: anuruddha → bhikkhave (bj) | upapajjati → upapajjatīti (bj) | mātugāmo → mātugāmo kāyassa (sya-all)
sn37.14:2.1: ti → As before (in the kaṇhapakkho) S1-3 repeat this sutta as applied to the bhikkhus, not to Anuruddha; and, in the following ones, they put always bhikkhave instead of Anuruddha (pts note) | aṭṭhasuttanta-saṅkhepā → In B1-2 only; B2 has saṅkhepi || la || (pts note) | Manāpā- → S1-3 manāpa (pts note)
sn37.14:2.2: āveṇikā tidhammo ca → āveṇiko tīhi dhammehi (bj) | āveṇikā tidhammo → hoti hirimā (pts) | ca → dve manāpāmanāpāca, āveṇikā tīhi anuruddho (cck: sabbattha) | Tīhi → S1-3 avenikānihi (pts note)
sn37.14:2.5: ca → ca anuruddho (bj) | dussīlo → dussīlaṁ (sya-all) | Dussīlo → B1 dussīlaṁ; B2 -lyam (pts note)
sn37.14:2.6: appassuto ca → vāppassuto (bj) | kusīto → kusito (sya-all) | Appassuto → S1-3 appassutā and put ca after kusīto (pts note) | Kusīto → B1-2 kusito (pts note)
sn37.14:2.8: kaṇhapakkhe pakāsito → pañcadasāti (bj) | pakāsito → S1-3 pakāsitā (pts note)
